svg.title: F chatbot evaluation
svg.desc: Chatbot correctness and response time. (a) Case-level agreement with frozen KG-derived references and software contracts. All listed scopes passed, but suites overlap and must not be summed. (b) Answerability and abstention outcomes for the same turns through JSON and SSE. Two additional reference-based no-data controls per transport are not part of the 40 answerable/12 abstention denominators. (c) Local sequential HTTP completion times: filled circles denote medians and open diamonds denote nearest-rank p95. Connecting lines are descriptive ranges, not confidence intervals. Measurements extend through body receipt, not first-token delivery. Agreement with KG records does not establish scientific or clinical validity.
